responses: Hello! I am CampusBot. How can I help you today?
Hi there! I am CampusBot. Ask me about admissions, fees, courses, exams, library or placements.
See you soon. All the best!

patterns: Which subjects are taught in MSc IT?
responses: We offer BSc IT, BSc CS, MSc IT and MSc Data Science. MSc IT includes Applied AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing and Blockchain.

patterns: How much are the fees for MSc IT?
Can I pay the fees online?
How many installments are there for fees?
responses: The MSc IT fee is Rs 45,000 per year, payable online in two installments (July and December).

patterns: How do I apply for admission?
What documents are required for admission?
What is the last date to apply?
responses: Admissions open in June. Apply online on the college portal with your marksheets, ID proof and passport-size photo. Merit lists are published in July.

patterns: When will the results be declared?
How do I get my hall ticket?
When does the exam timetable come out?
How many marks are needed to pass?
responses: Semester exams are held in November and April. Hall tickets are available on the portal one week before the exam; results are declared within 45 days.

patterns: Is the college open on Saturday?
responses: The college runs from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. The office is open from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

patterns: Can I borrow books from the library?
How many books can I issue?
What is the fine for late return of books?
responses: The library is open from 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Students can issue up to 3 books for 14 days. E-books are available on the portal.

patterns: How many students got placed last year?
responses: The placement cell conducts training and campus drives every year. Companies from IT, banking and analytics visit the campus. Internships are offered in the final year.

patterns: How can I contact the college?
What is the office email address?
Whom should I contact for help?
responses: You can reach the college office at 022-0000-0000 or office@college.edu. The campus is in Mulund, Mumbai.

responses: Sorry, I can only answer questions about the college: admissions, fees, courses, timings, library, exams, placements and contact details.
